note: Both sets show the same systematic artifact of truncating the E+6 exponent in table values, but Set A additionally invents -113.40E+6 for the 23.0 m/s row (table: -114.30E+6), misbinds 23.0 m/s as a blade-pitch angle, and pads its list with four trivial 'row/column value' claims plus several duplicates. Set B's only substantive numeric error is -83.04E+6 for the 18.0 m/s row (table: -83.94E+6), and it correctly captures Equations 7-16a and 7-16b, the rated mechanical power 5.296610 MW and the rated rotor speed 12.1 rpm, all of which Set A omits. Row coverage of Table 7-1 is comparable (each set drops three rows), so B's additional correct model and rated-value claims and its fewer trivial claims make it the better set despite one more truncated-value claim.
